description: Produce a deterministic brand guideline skeleton. Pass `name` (required), and optionally `audience`, `tone` (words, comma separated or a list) and `constraints` (a list or lines such as "must meet WCAG AA" or "no stock photography"). Returns thirteen sections (purpose, audience, voice, logo, colour, typography, layout and shape, imagery, iconography, motion, accessibility, channels, governance). Each lists what you already decided, the decisions still open and blank lines to fill in. Tone words are matched to a fixed table of design levers (type, colour, shape, motion, voice) and pairs that pull against each other are named; words not in the table are listed as needing a definition. Constraints are sorted into accessibility, legal, existing assets, channels, language, budget and exclusions and shown in the sections they affect. Nothing is generated beyond these templates, so the same input always gives the same output.

constraints.description: Constraints, one per line or a list.

tone.description: Tone words, comma separated or a list.

name: draft_brand_checklist
title: Brand guideline checklist
